note: v1, written: THE ROOM TURNS. Lo-fi deep house (the style board's t17 row), 122 -> 120 bpm (the ramp in the last 32 bars), D minor (7A). 5:17. The featured illusion is THE ROOM THAT TURNS (precedence / Haas): a swung loop of rims and shaker on the 16ths, played by four dusty-kit tracks - a left-leading pair (the right side 18 ms late) and a right-leading pair (the reverse) - crossfaded by complementary 6-bar sine LFOs.
